structure.title: NCHMCT JEE Syllabus for English Language
structure.summary: The partial document outlines the syllabus for the NCHMCT JEE exam, specifically covering the English Language and General Knowledge & Current Affairs sections. The English Language section focuses on grammar, vocabulary, comprehension, and sentence structure. The General Knowledge & Current Affairs section emphasizes current events, science, history, geography, and general knowledge related to India and the world.

structure.title: NCHMCT JEE Syllabus for General Knowledge & Current Affairs
structure.summary: The document outlines the syllabus for the NCHMCT JEE exam, specifically covering the English Language and General Knowledge & Current Affairs sections. The English Language section includes topics such as grammar, unseen passages, vocabulary, sentence structure, and comprehension. The General Knowledge & Current Affairs section focuses on current events, science, history, geography, economics, and general politics, with an emphasis on India and its neighboring countries.

structure.title: NCHMCT JEE Syllabus for Reasoning and Logical Deduction
structure.summary: The document outlines the syllabus for the NCHMCT JEE exam, specifically focusing on Reasoning and Logical Deduction, and Aptitude for the Service Sector. The Reasoning and Logical Deduction section tests thinking ability and includes topics such as classification, series, analogies, analytical reasoning, arrangements, coding/decoding, data sufficiency, syllogism, data interpretation, direction/distances, alphabet test, blood relationships, and problems based on visual ability. The Aptitude for Service Sector section covers aptitude questions related to hotel management, where answers are evaluated based on appropriateness rather than correctness.

structure.title: NCHMCT JEE Syllabus for Aptitude for Service Sector
structure.summary: The document outlines the syllabus for two sections of the NCHMCT JEE exam: Reasoning and Logical Deduction, and Aptitude for Service Sector. The Reasoning and Logical Deduction section tests thinking ability and includes topics like classification, series, analogies, analytical reasoning, arrangements, coding/decoding, data sufficiency, syllogism, data interpretation, direction/distances, alphabet tests, blood relationships, and problems based on visual ability. The Aptitude for Service Sector section covers aptitude questions related to hotel management, where the most appropriate answer is awarded marks instead of a single correct answer.
